_readme: テイスト（撮影スタイル）のマスタ。確定プロンプト PR-01〜PR-04 を12ブロックに分解したもの。
・英文はそのまま画像生成AIに渡ります。日本語で書いても効きません。
・{{PRODUCT}} は商品マスタ(products.json)の appearance が入る差し込み記号です。消さないでください。
・blocks の各項目は『組み立て順』のとおりに連結されます。空文字にするとその段落は出力されません。
・JSONの書式（カンマ・ダブルクォート）を壊すとデプロイが失敗します。その場合、本番は前のバージョンのまま残るので安全です。
組み立て順: reset → mediumAngle → ground → props → wordmark → productPlacement → extras(手打ち) → composition(用途) → light → texture → fidelity → negatives(共通) → format(用途)
status: confirmed=実生成で検証済み / candidate=未検証 / pending-approval=本社確認待ち（実運用しない）
suitablePurposes: そのテイストを表示する用途のid（purposes.json）。ig / ig_story / ec_hero。EC商品画像(ec_square)は用途側が背景を全部決めるためテイストは使いません。

tones.label: PR-01 標準形：コットン巾着＋白大理石
tones.note: チューブ系全商品の標準ビジュアル。2026-09-09に狙いどおりの1枚が出た確定形。

blocks.reset: Create a completely new photograph. Do not reuse the attached images as compositions — discard their backgrounds, their rounded corners, their studio lighting, their camera angles and their carton boxes entirely. The carton boxes must not appear. The attached images are only locked references for the products themselves.
blocks.mediumAngle: The photograph looks like a casual, unstyled snapshot taken on a smartphone from above a table — honest and a little imperfect, not a professional studio shot. The camera looks down from a high angle that is close to overhead but noticeably tilted, so the scene is seen slightly obliquely rather than perfectly square to the surface.
blocks.ground: The surface is a white marble slab with soft grey veining. Filling the left two thirds of the frame is a crumpled cream-coloured cotton drawstring pouch of coarse plain weave, its gathered top, twisted cord and soft folds clearly visible.
blocks.wordmark: Printed across the upper area of the pouch is a single line of text reading Pharmesthetic — spelled letter by letter as P, h, a, r, m, e, s, t, h, e, t, i, c, one capital P followed by twelve lowercase letters, thirteen letters in total and no other characters. It is set in a fine classical serif with generous letter spacing, spanning roughly half the width of the pouch, sitting on a flat well-lit area of cloth so it stays fully legible, screen-printed in soft dark navy ink that sinks into the weave. Do not add a second line, a tagline, a web address, a registered trademark symbol or any border around it. If you cannot spell it exactly, leave the pouch blank.
blocks.productPlacement: Lying diagonally on the pouch, below the printed word, is {{PRODUCT}}, its printed face turned toward the camera, sinking very slightly into the soft cloth, its cap screwed on. Nothing else is in the frame — no boxes, no cards, no other products, no plants, no props.
blocks.light: The light is soft, cool indoor daylight coming from the upper left, as if from a window on an overcast day, producing gentle low-contrast shadows toward the lower right under the tube and along the folds of the cloth. No hard flash, no rim light, no studio lighting.
blocks.texture: The image must look like a real phone photograph, not a 3D render, not a mockup and not a composite: slightly soft focus, mild grain, muted contrast, a faint natural vignette, and the small imperfections of an unedited snapshot.

tones.label: PR-02 クラフト紙＋潰れたチューブ（情報密度型）
tones.note: ラベルの文字密度が資産の商材向き（グリーンボクシン等）。青×クラフト茶、橙×クラフト茶ともに補色で映える。

blocks.reset: Create a completely new photograph. Do not edit or reuse the attached image as a composition — discard its background, its rounded corners, its clean studio lighting, its camera angle and its carton box entirely. The carton box must not appear. The attached image is only a locked reference for the product itself.
blocks.mediumAngle: The photograph looks like a casual, unstyled snapshot taken on a smartphone from above a table at home — honest and a little imperfect, not a professional studio shot. The camera looks down at the surface from a high angle that is close to overhead but noticeably tilted, so the scene is seen slightly obliquely rather than perfectly square to the table.
blocks.ground: Lying on a plain white table is a large sheet of brown recycled kraft paper, softly wrinkled, its torn ragged edge running across the lower right of the frame so that a corner of the bare white table shows through at the top left.
blocks.props: The kraft paper is printed all over in black ink with dense, fine, small-set text arranged in narrow columns with thin horizontal rules — the printing must read purely as a texture of tiny illegible marks, with no readable words, no headlines, no names and no numbers anywhere.
blocks.productPlacement: Two identical units of the product lie on the kraft paper at a loose diagonal, roughly parallel to each other but slightly askew, one a little higher in the frame than the other, their printed faces turned toward the camera. Each one is {{PRODUCT}}. The first is full and pristine, holding its clean original shape. The second, identical one looks gently used, its surface showing the soft marks of real handling — a few natural creases where the material has given way — while its printed lettering remains completely intact and readable. It looks lived-in, never damaged, dirty or leaking. Both caps stay on. They overlap the printed paper so the black text runs behind and around them. Nothing else is in the frame — no box, no other products, no plants, no props.
blocks.light: The light is soft, warm indoor daylight coming from one side, as if from a window on a bright day, producing gentle low-contrast shadows and a faintly warm cast across the paper. No hard flash, no rim light, no studio lighting.
blocks.texture: The image must look like a real phone photograph, not a 3D render, not a mockup and not a composite: slightly soft focus, mild grain, muted contrast, a faint natural vignette in the corners, and the small imperfections of an unedited snapshot.
